description: This file defines the NoteRequest DTO (Data Transfer Object) used for creating or updating notes in the backend API. It contains fields for title and content, along with validation and schema annotations, as well as getter and setter methods.

classes.name: NoteRequest
classes.description: DTO class for note creation or update requests, containing title and content fields with validation and schema annotations.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note.
